verdict.rationale: Docs say all content is stored locally in an on-device Vault and the app is offline-first and always works without internet. A local-only mode drops the backup node entirely, and a community user confirms it works offline. The 'read without the app' part is not met: users report the local store is opaque Electron blob files with no raw Markdown or CSV and no configurable storage path. Outside access is only possible through Markdown export. Missing for 10: notes stored as directly readable open-format files, a user-controlled storage location, and app-independent access without export.
